protocol.validation: A separate one-token pass saves first-token logits for both fixed prompts before each timed case, with a new Generator and empty recurrent prefix cache each time.
protocol.timing: Timed decode intervals are generated_tokens minus one, excluding time to first token. Pooled throughput sums timed intervals and divides by summed decode seconds.
protocol.sequence_design: ABCCBA: two repetitions per variant, with MTP-2 controls bracketing both draft-window choices
